name: Classic Beef Lasagna

components.name: Beef Lasagna

ingredients.name: Low-sodium beef stock instead of wine

steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil until softened. Brown the beef, breaking up lumps; drain substantial excess fat if produced.
Add tomato, tomato paste, stock, oregano and seasoning. Simmer uncovered until thick enough to layer without leaking excess liquid.
For béchamel melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour, then gradually whisk in milk and cook until smooth and lightly thickened. Add nutmeg and salt.
Preheat oven to 180 C. Spread a thin layer of ragù in a deep baking dish, then layer pasta sheets, ragù, béchamel and cheese; repeat until ingredients are used.
Cover loosely with foil and bake about 30 minutes, uncover and bake another 15-20 minutes until bubbling and pasta tender.
Let rest for at least 20 minutes before cutting into eight substantial squares; cool quickly before portioning.

Refrigerate at 4 C or below for 3-4 days maximum; freeze later-week portions soon after cooking.
Reheat cooked leftovers to 74 C. Cook ground beef and lamb to 71 C. Whole-cut lamb and beef should reach at least 63 C and rest 3 minutes; use a food thermometer.
When a recipe includes rice, cool it rapidly and store cold immediately; avoid leaving cooked rice at room temperature.
Freeze in suitable airtight food-safe containers. Defrost in refrigerator, not on counter. Reheat crisp foods in oven when possible.
